method: Whole-repository inventory and AST screening; risk-based reading across every workspace and critical boundaries; targeted reproducers and full workspace checks. Not a claim of manual line-by-line proof.
limits: Historical migrations and acceptance reports were evidence, not current topology.
No production faults, live model calls, real browser/Cube acceptance or physical multi-node HA test in this review.
Cube patch manifests and integration boundaries were reviewed; the upstream Rust/Go fork was not rebuilt/retested in this review.
AST query-operation counts are syntactic occurrences, not measured database round trips.
